name: Document Browser with Breadcrumbs
summary: Document and file browser with breadcrumb navigation, NavigationMenu sections with quick-access grids, folder/file listing using Item components (ItemMedia, ItemContent, ItemActions, ItemGroup, ItemSeparator, ItemTitle, ItemDescription), BreadcrumbEllipsis with DropdownMenu for deep paths, file action buttons (download, share, delete), and folder click-to-navigate that updates breadcrumbs dynamically. Uses useAppState for current path and useNavigation for section switching.
shortSummary: File browser with breadcrumb navigation, folder tree, NavigationMenu sections, and Item-based file listings

DocumentBrowser.summary: Document browser with breadcrumb trail, navigation menu sections, folder/file items with actions, and drill-down navigation
